description: Compare a quoted price for a known service against ARI's current fair-market value (FMV) band. Returns a verdict (green/amber/red), the FMV, the band, the percentile, the sample size, and a citable signed receipt id.

unit.description: Unit code (e.g. tokens, calls, seconds). Required so the quote is compared against the correct unit's FMV band.

name: is_fair_price
title: Check if a quoted price is fair
